BiblicalUsage: ʼEshqᵉlôwnîy means Ashkelonite or inhabitant of Ashkelon. It occurs just once, in Joshua.
TheologicalSignificance: I take ʼEshqᵉlôwnîy as it stands — Ashkelonite or inhabitant of Ashkelon — and read the passage with that plain sense in mind.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
